::: {.callout-tip}
## Try before comparing

The code links in this guided lab download intentionally incomplete **starter
files**. Complete the requested work and run your own checks first. After you
have made a serious attempt, use the direct **Possible solutions** links at the
end of this page to compare approaches. The possible solution is not the only
correct program. All pairs are also listed in the [code library](../code/index.qmd).

The starter supplies only the given setup and `TODO` prompts. When a lab says
to run or inspect a result, first complete the corresponding `TODO`, then run
your version.
:::
